/// @notice Optimized sorting and set operations library for memory arrays.
/// @author Solady (https://github.com/vectorized/solady/blob/main/src/utils/LibSort.sol)
library LibSort {
    /*´:°•.°+.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°•.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°+.*•´.*:*/
    /*                    INSERTION SORT                          */
    /*.•°:°.´+˚.*°.˚:*.´•*.+°.•°:´*.´•*.•°.•°:°.´:•˚°.*°.˚:*.´+°.•*/

    /// @notice Performs an insertion sort on an array of unsigned integers in-place.
    ///
    /// @dev This function uses low-level assembly for optimization and memory safety.
    /// The array is sorted in ascending order.
    ///
    /// Steps:
    /// 1. Load the length of the array `a` into `n`.
    /// 2. Temporarily set the length of `a` to 0 to ensure the inner loop terminates correctly.
    /// 3. Calculate the high slot (`h`) of the array for loop termination.
    /// 4. Initialize the loop with the first element of the array.
    /// 5. For each element in the array:
    ///    a. Load the current element (`k`).
    ///    b. Compare it with the previous element (`v`).
    ///    c. If the previous element is greater than the current element, shift the previous elements to the right until the correct position for `k` is found.
    ///    d. Insert `k` into its correct position.
    /// 6. Restore the original length of the array `a` after sorting.
    function insertionSort(uint256[] memory a) internal pure {
        /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
        assembly {
            let n := mload(a)
            // Store the length of the array temporarily as 0.
            mstore(a, 0)
            let h := add(a, shl(5, n))
            if iszero(lt(n, 2)) {
                let l := add(a, 0x20)
                for {
                    let i := l
                } lt(i, h) {
                    i := add(i, 0x20)
                } {
                    let k := mload(i)
                    let v := mload(sub(i, 0x20))
                    if gt(v, k) {
                        let j := i
                        for {
                        } 1 {
                            j := sub(j, 0x20)
                        } {
                            mstore(j, v)
                            v := mload(sub(j, 0x40))
                            if iszero(gt(v, k)) {
                                break
                            }
                        }
                        mstore(j, k)
                    }
                }
            }
            // Restore the length of the array.
            mstore(a, n)
        }
    }

    /// @notice Performs an insertion sort on an array of signed integers in-place.
    function insertionSort(int256[] memory a) internal pure {
        insertionSort(_toUints(a));

    /*.•°:°.´+˚.*°.˚:*.´•*.+°.•°:´*.´•*.•°.•°:°.´:•˚°.*°.˚:*.´+°.•*/

    /// @notice Sorts an array of unsigned integers in ascending order using a combination of insertion sort and quicksort.
    ///
    /// The function uses inline assembly for optimized performance and memory safety.
    ///
    /// Steps:
    /// 1. Check if the array length is less than 2. If true, the array is already sorted, so exit.
    /// 2. Define helper functions:
    ///    - `swap`: Swaps two values.
    ///    - `mswap`: Swaps two memory slots.
    ///    - `sortInner`: Recursively sorts the array using a combination of insertion sort and quicksort.
    /// 3. Perform insertion sort if the array size is small (threshold fine-tuned via trial and error).
    /// 4. For larger arrays, use quicksort:
    ///    - Select a pivot using the median-of-three method.
    ///    - Partition the array around the pivot using Hoare's partition scheme.
    ///    - Recursively sort the sub-arrays.
    /// 5. Handle edge cases:
    ///    - If the array is already sorted, exit early.
    ///    - If the array is reverse-sorted, reverse it in place.
    /// 6. Restore the array length after sorting.
    ///
    /// @param a The array of unsigned integers to be sorted.
    function sort(uint256[] memory a) internal pure {
        /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
        assembly {
            let n := mload(a)
            if lt(n, 2) {
                break
            }
            // Temporarily set the length of `a` to 0.
            mstore(a, 0)
            let h := add(a, shl(5, n))
            // `l` is the low slot, `h` is the high slot.
            let l := add(a, 0x20)

            // If the array is already sorted, exit early.
            let p := l
            for {
                let i := add(l, 0x20)
            } lt(i, h) {
                i := add(i, 0x20)
            } {
                if lt(mload(i), mload(p)) {
                    break
                }
                p := i
            }
            if eq(p, sub(h, 0x20)) {
                mstore(a, n)
                break
            }

            // If the array is reverse sorted, reverse it.
            p := l
            let q := sub(h, 0x20)
            for {
                let i := add(l, 0x20)
            } lt(i, h) {
                i := add(i, 0x20)
            } {
                if iszero(lt(mload(i), mload(p))) {
                    break
                }
                p := i
            }
            if eq(p, sub(h, 0x20)) {
                for {
                } lt(l, q) {
                    l := add(l, 0x20)
                    q := sub(q, 0x20)
                } {
                    let v := mload(l)
                    mstore(l, mload(q))
                    mstore(q, v)
                }
                mstore(a, n)
                break
            }
            // The length of `a` is temporarily 0.
            mstore(a, n)

            // Sort using quicksort.
            // prettier-ignore
            function swap(x, y) { x := mload(x) y := mload(y) mstore(x, y) mstore(y, x) }
            // prettier-ignore
            function mswap(x, y) { let v := mload(x) mstore(x, mload(y)) mstore(y, v) }

            // eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
            function sortInner(l, h) {
                // If the number of elements is less than or equal to 42, use insertion sort.
                // The constant 42 is fine-tuned via trial and error.
                if lt(sub(h, l), 0x540) {
                    for {
                        let i := add(l, 0x20)
                    } lt(i, h) {
                        i := add(i, 0x20)
                    } {
                        let k := mload(i)
                        let v := mload(sub(i, 0x20))
                        if gt(v, k) {
                            let j := i
                            for {
                            } 1 {
                                j := sub(j, 0x20)
                            } {
                                mstore(j, v)
                                v := mload(sub(j, 0x40))
                                if iszero(gt(v, k)) {
                                    break
                                }
                            }
                            mstore(j, k)
                        }
                    }
                    // stop
                }

                // Median-of-three pivot selection.
                let m := add(shr(1, add(l, h)), and(add(l, h), 0x1f))
                let v := mload(l)
                let w := mload(m)
                if gt(v, w) {
                    mswap(l, m)
                    v := mload(l)
                    w := mload(m)
                }
                let x := mload(sub(h, 0x20))
                if gt(w, x) {
                    mswap(m, sub(h, 0x20))
                    x := mload(m)
                    w := mload(sub(h, 0x20))
                    if gt(v, w) {
                        mswap(l, m)
                        v := mload(l)
                        w := mload(m)
                    }
                }
                mswap(m, sub(h, 0x20))
                x := w
                // Hoare's partition scheme.
                let i := sub(l, 0x20)
                let j := h
                for {
                } 1 {
                    for {
                        i := add(i, 0x20)
                    } lt(mload(i), x) {
                        i := add(i, 0x20)
                    }
                    for {
                        j := sub(j, 0x20)
                    } lt(x, mload(j)) {
                        j := sub(j, 0x20)
                    }
                    if iszero(lt(i, j)) {
                        break
                    }
                    swap(i, j)
                }
                mswap(i, sub(h, 0x20))
                // Sort the sub-arrays.
                sortInner(l, i)
                sortInner(add(i, 0x20), h)
            }

            sortInner(l, h)
            // Restore the length of the array.
        }
    }

                i := add(i, 0x20)
            } {
                if iszero(lt(mload(i), mload(p))) {
                    break

                p := i

            if eq(p, sub(h, 0x20)) {

                    l := add(l, 0x20)
                    q := sub(q, 0x20)
                } {
                    let v := mload(l)
                    mstore(l, mload(q))
                    mstore(q, v)
                }
                mstore(a, n)
                break
            }
            // The length of `a` is temporarily 0.
            mstore(a, n)

            // Sort using quicksort.
            // prettier-ignore
            function swap(x, y) { x := mload(x) y := mload(y) mstore(x, y) mstore(y, x) }
            // prettier-ignore
            function mswap(x, y) { let v := mload(x) mstore(x, mload(y)) mstore(y, v) }

                        let i := add(l, 0x20)
                    } lt(i, h) {
                        i := add(i, 0x20)

                        let v := mload(sub(i, 0x20))

                                v := mload(sub(j, 0x40))
                                if iszero(gt(v, k)) {

                // Median-of-three pivot selection.
                let m := add(shr(1, add(l, h)), and(add(l, h), 0x1f))
                let v := mload(l)
                let w := mload(m)
                if gt(v, w) {
                    mswap(l, m)
                    v := mload(l)
                    w := mload(m)
                }
                let x := mload(sub(h, 0x20))
                if gt(w, x) {
                    mswap(m, sub(h, 0x20))
                    x := mload(m)
                    w := mload(sub(h, 0x20))
                    if gt(v, w) {
                        mswap(l, m)
                        v := mload(l)
                        w := mload(m)
                    }
                }
                mswap(m, sub(h, 0x20))
                x := w
                // Hoare's partition scheme.
                let i := sub(l, 0x20)
                let j := h
                for {
                } 1 {
                    for {
                        i := add(i, 0x20)
                    } lt(mload(i), x) {
                        i := add(i, 0x20)
                    }
                    for {
                        j := sub(j, 0x20)
                    } lt(x, mload(j)) {
                        j := sub(j, 0x20)
                    }
                    if iszero(lt(i, j)) {
                        break
                    }
                    swap(i, j)
                }
                mswap(i, sub(h, 0x20))
                // Sort the sub-arrays.
                sortInner(l, i)
                sortInner(add(i, 0x20), h)
            }

            sortInner(l, h)
            // Restore the length of the array.
        }
    }
